name: x-train-route-2-south
objective: AN EXPERIMENT, NOT A LINK. The same job as link 11 - raise the lead to level 10 before Viridian Forest - done in the grass at the southern end of Route 2 instead of on Route 1, to measure whether anywhere pre-forest trains faster than Route 1 does.
evidence: An experiment. Route 2's southern grass is rows 48-51 of map $0D, 24 tiles, found by reading the tileset's own grass tile ($52) out of the block map. Its encounter table is the same one the northern half uses - Gen 1 keeps one wild table per map - averaging 29.4 experience against Route 1's 25.0.
